name: Heavy Greater Permafrost · Cold ×2
primary:
A projectile flies in an arc where you look and strikes the first target. Effects:
• Damage 6.25 ❤ earth (earth ×2 on frozen)
• Cold 72: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Launches upward
• Breaks up to 22 blocks within 2.17 blocks (twice as many if brittle)
• Cold 80: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Slowness III for 9 s
